column3: NASB renders “bear witness to yourselves” as “testify against yourselves.”
NASB renders the command as “Fill up, then” and adds “of the guilt.”
NASB adds “the guilt of” and renders “come upon” as “fall.”
NASB renders the closing question as a statement (“and you were unwilling”).
NASB renders “is left” as “is being left.”
Close to the Greek; the quotation is in capitals.
